prompt: Create a bright wide-angle editorial interior photograph of a playful maximalist apartment living room, shot from a low corner perspective with slight smartphone lens distortion and warm natural daylight. The room features a cobalt-blue curved sofa against a cream wall, with a relaxed middle-aged woman named Anna sitting on the floor leaning against it, smiling at the camera; she has short copper-red hair, wears a loose lavender T-shirt, green striped wide-leg pants, and light socks. The decor is colorful and Memphis-inspired: a large cream shag rug with black diagonal stripes plus exactly 3 large colored shapes, a blue circle in the foreground, a red oval near the sofa, and a red rectangle on the right. Include exactly 5 pillows on the sofa: one black-and-white striped pillow, one red-and-white checker pillow, one pale pink round shell-like pillow, one pale pink rectangular pillow, and one mustard yellow pillow. On the wall above the sofa, show exactly 4 framed abstract art prints arranged in a loose grid, with bold red, blue, pink, yellow, and black geometric shapes. Add exactly 2 wavy mirrors: a tall blue wavy mirror beside the art over the sofa and a smaller pink wavy mirror in the dining area on the right. On the left, place a large monstera plant beside a glossy stacked burgundy-red side table topped with a pink mushroom lamp. In the foreground right, place a low rounded yellow coffee table with glossy red bulbous legs, holding exactly 3 items: an open magazine, a white mug with a red handle, and a coral-pink sculptural tray. In the background, show an open-plan kitchen and dining space with white walls, wood floor, yellow cabinetry, a red refrigerator panel or tall red cabinet, bookshelves, trailing plants, and a small dining table with wooden chairs. Hang exactly 2 ceiling pendants visible: an orange dome-and-glass pendant near the top right and a partial white pendant at the far right edge. Use a cheerful retro-modern palette of cobalt blue, cream, red, yellow, pink, orange, and leafy green; maintain realistic shadows, glossy surfaces, cozy lived-in details, high dynamic range, crisp focus, and an Instagram home-tour photography feel. Add a small black circular watermark with white “AI” text in the bottom-left corner.

promptZh: 创作一张明亮的广角编辑风格室内摄影作品，展示一间充满趣味的极繁主义公寓客厅。采用低角度角落视角拍摄，带有轻微的智能手机镜头畸变，并呈现温暖的自然日光。房间内设有一张靠在米色墙壁前的钴蓝色弧形沙发，一位名叫 Anna 的中年女性正坐在地板上靠着沙发，微笑着看向镜头；她留着短铜红色头发，身穿宽松的淡紫色 T 恤、绿色条纹阔腿裤，脚穿浅色袜子。装饰风格色彩丰富且充满孟菲斯元素：一张带有黑色斜条纹的大型米色长绒地毯，以及恰好 3 个大型彩色形状，前景为一个蓝色圆圈，沙发附近为一个红色椭圆，右侧为一个红色长方形。沙发上放置恰好 5 个靠垫：一个黑白条纹靠垫、一个红白方格靠垫、一个淡粉色圆形贝壳状靠垫、一个淡粉色长方形靠垫以及一个芥末黄靠垫。沙发上方的墙上悬挂恰好 4 幅抽象艺术画框，以松散的网格排列，包含大胆的红、蓝、粉、黄、黑几何图形。添加恰好 2 面波浪镜：沙发上方艺术画旁的一面高大的蓝色波浪镜，以及右侧用餐区的一面较小的粉色波浪镜。左侧放置一株大型龟背竹，旁边是一个光泽感十足的酒红色堆叠式边几，上面放着一盏粉色蘑菇灯。右侧前景放置一张低矮的圆形黄色咖啡桌，配有光泽感的红色球状桌腿，桌上放有恰好 3 件物品：一本打开的杂志、一个带红色手柄的白色马克杯以及一个珊瑚粉色雕塑感托盘。背景展示了一个开放式厨房和用餐空间，配有白墙、木地板、黄色橱柜、红色冰箱面板或高大的红色橱柜、书架、垂吊植物以及一张配有木椅的小餐桌。悬挂恰好 2 盏可见的吊灯：右上角附近的一盏橙色圆顶玻璃吊灯，以及最右侧边缘的一盏部分可见的白色吊灯。使用由 钴蓝色、米色、红色、黄色、粉色、橙色和叶绿色组成的欢快复古现代配色方案；保持逼真的阴影、光泽表面、舒适的生活化细节、高动态范围、清晰的对焦，以及 Instagram 家居探访摄影的质感。在左下角添加一个带有白色“AI”文字的小型黑色圆形水印。
